note: Ablation over the factorized evolving space of Section 3.3. The fixed-graph arm holds |N| and H at the initialization and edits only the role assignment, the completion predicates, and the shared rule/culture. The full arm is the unrestricted space. Every value is read off an executed deployed chain, not re-simulated. On DevEval, DDR-Bench and TheAgentCompany the deployed chain never edited |N| or H (verified per round from strategy.yaml), so the best protocol found under the full space already lies inside the fixed-graph subspace and the two arms coincide. On OfficeQA Pro they separate, and both arms are scored on the same 133 tasks as data/fixed_topology.json.
